```python
# Compare total losses from deaths in prisons & camps vs deaths outside of prisons & camps
in_prisons = df.loc[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths In Prisons & Camps', 'Total'].values[0]
outside_prisons = df.loc[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps', 'Total'].values[0]

if in_prisons > outside_prisons:
    answer = "Deaths in prisons & camps"
else:
    answer = "Deaths outside of prisons & camps"

print(f"Deaths in prisons & camps: {in_prisons}")
print(f"Deaths outside of prisons & camps: {outside_prisons}")
print(f"Answer: {answer}")
```

**Answer:** Deaths in **prisons & camps** caused more losses (1,146,000) compared to deaths outside of prisons & camps (473,000).
